 ```cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <unordered_map>

std::vector<std::string> processInput(const std::vector<std::string>& input) {
    std::vector<std::string> result;
    std::unordered_map<std::string, int> wordCount;

    for (const auto& str : input) {
        std::string lowerStr = str;
        std::transform(lowerStr.begin(), lowerStr.end(), lowerStr.begin(), 
                       [](unsigned char c){ return std::tolower(c); });

        if (wordCount.find(lowerStr) != wordCount.end()) {
            wordCount[lowerStr]++;
        } else {
            wordCount[lowerStr] = 1;
        }
    }

    for (const auto& pair : wordCount) {
        result.push_back(pair.first + ": " + std::to_string(pair.second));
    }

    return result;
}
```

/**
Decode the JSON Web Token (JWT) and return its claims. The token is encoded with the HS256 algorithm. If the decoding fails, return an empty JSON object string.

@param token The JWT token to decode.
@param key The key used in encoding.

@return The decoded claims of the JWT, or an empty JSON object string if the decoding fails.

std::string decode_json_web_token(const std::string& token, const std::string& key) {
Solution: ```cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <unordered_map>

std::vector<std::string> processInput(const std::vector<std::string>& input) {
    std::vector<std::string> result;
    std::unordered_map<std::string, int> wordCount;

    for (const auto& str : input) {
        std::string lowerStr = str;
        std::transform(lowerStr.begin(), lowerStr.end(), lowerStr.begin(), 
                       [](unsigned char c){ return std::tolower(c); });

        if (wordCount.find(lowerStr) != wordCount.end()) {
            wordCount[lowerStr]++;
        } else {
            wordCount[lowerStr] = 1;
        }
    }

    for (const auto& pair : wordCount) {
        result.push_back(pair.first + ": " + std::to_string(pair.second));
    }

    return result;
}
```

#include <jwt.h>
#include <string>
#include <stdexcept>

std::string decode_json_web_token(const std::string& token, const std::string& key) {
    std::string decoded;
    jwt_t* jwt = jwt_decode(token.c_str(), key.c_str(), JWT_VERIFY);
    if (!jwt) {
        return "{}";
    }
    decoded = jwt_get_decoded_token(jwt);
    jwt_free(jwt);
    return decoded;
}
```
